description: This Go source file provides functions to parse Markdown content, extract translatable segments, and apply translations to Markdown documents. It utilizes the goldmark library for Markdown parsing and operates by walking the AST to identify relevant text segments.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Extracts translatable segments from Markdown content by parsing the document, walking the AST, and collecting text nodes in translatable blocks, while handling code blocks and other non-translatable sections.

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Replaces the original segments in the Markdown body with their translated counterparts, reconstructing the full content with translations applied.
